openMenuKey.name: Open menu
openMenuKey.description: The key that opens MineClub+. This is the only place it can be changed.

avatarStyle.name: Player image
avatarStyle.description: How your skin is shown in the menu. Bust renders your skin via mccatalog.com, which receives your UUID; Head stays fully offline.

refreshWhileOpen.name: Refresh automatically
refreshWhileOpen.description: Fetches new data while the menu is open. Off means only on open and on Refresh.

confirmTransporterActions.name: Confirm actions
confirmTransporterActions.description: Ask before sending a transporter command to the server.

quickAmount.name: Default amount
quickAmount.description: How many items Take to inventory requests.

openDashboard.name: Open MineClub+
openDashboard.description: Opens the window from here, for players who would rather click than use the hotkey.
